items.title: Descent of the blow-up square condition for complexes in the essential image of the derived pushforward

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma characterizes which bounded below complexes of modules on the finer site lie in the essential image of the derived pushforward along epsilon, by the requirement that the canonical maps attached to a family of commutative squares be isomorphisms (statement lines 6669-6695). The proof is a complete argument: after disposing of the trivial cases (proof lines 6698-6700) the author introduces property (P), factors an arbitrary complex through the adjunction triangle so that the remainder has vanishing pullback (proof lines 6702-6716), and then proves that a complex with (P) and vanishing pullback has no cohomology at all by producing, in the lowest degree where cohomology could live, an exact sequence in which assumption (1) and the vanishing of the pullback force the vanishing (proof lines 6720-6754). The non-formal content is the reduction to the pullback-acyclic case and the degree argument. The claim is H2: a structured reduction with each input named.
